```python
import itertools, time, sys

def search(k, maxs, timelimit):
    n = 4+k
    F = 3
    assigns = [a for a in range(1<<n) if not (a>>F)&1]
    full = (1<<len(assigns))-1
    clauses = []
    for (i,j,l) in itertools.combinations(range(n),3):
        for si in (0,1):
            for sj in (0,1):
                for sl in (0,1):
                    m=0
                    for ai,a in enumerate(assigns):
                        li=((a>>i)&1)^si
                        lj=((a>>j)&1)^sj
                        ll=((a>>l)&1)^sl
                        if li+lj+ll==1: m|=1<<ai
                    clauses.append(((i,j,l,si,sj,sl),m))
    # dedupe masks? keep
    def proj(m):
        pats=set()
        while m:
            low=m&(-m); ai=low.bit_length()-1; a=assigns[ai]
            pats.add(((a>>0)&1,(a>>1)&1,(a>>2)&1)); m^=low
        return pats
    need={(x,y,z) for x in(0,1) for y in(0,1) for z in(0,1) if (x,y,z)!=(0,0,0)}
    start=time.time()
    res=[None]
    def dfs(si,depth,cur,chosen):
        if res[0] is not None or time.time()-start>timelimit: return
        p=proj(cur)
        if not need<=p: return
        if p==need:
            res[0]=list(chosen); return
        if depth==maxs: return
        for i in range(si,len(clauses)):
            nm=cur&clauses[i][1]
            if nm==0: continue
            chosen.append(clauses[i][0])
            dfs(i+1,depth+1,nm,chosen)
            chosen.pop()
            if res[0] is not None: return
    dfs(0,0,full,[])
    return res[0]
```

```python
import itertools, sys, time

def build_candidates(n, F):
    cands = []
    for (i,j,l) in itertools.combinations(range(n),3):
        for si in (0,1):
            for sj in (0,1):
                for sl in (0,1):
                    cands.append((i,j,l,si,sj,sl))
    return cands

def mask_of(c, n, F, assigns):
    i,j,l,si,sj,sl = c
    m=0
    for ai,a in enumerate(assigns):
        li=((a>>i)&1)^si
        lj=((a>>j)&1)^sj
        ll=((a>>l)&1)^sl
        if li+lj+ll==1: m|=1<<ai
    return m

def proj_ok(m, assigns):
    pats=set()
    mm=m
    while mm:
        low=mm&(-mm); ai=low.bit_length()-1; a=assigns[ai]
        pats.add(((a>>0)&1,(a>>1)&1,(a>>2)&1)); mm^=low
    return pats

def search(n, F, maxsize):
    assigns=[a for a in range(1<<n) if not (a>>F)&1]
    cands=build_candidates(n,F)
    masks=[mask_of(c,n,F,assigns) for c in cands]
    need={(x,y,z) for x in(0,1) for y in(0,1) for z in(0,1) if (x,y,z)!=(0,0,0)}
    for size in range(1,maxsize+1):
        cnt=0

            m=(1<<len(assigns))-1
            for ci in combo: m&=masks[ci]
            if m==0: continue
            p=proj_ok(m,assigns)
            if p==need:
                return [cands[ci] for ci in combo]
        print("  size",size,"done", flush=True)
    return None
```

```python
import itertools, sys, time

def search(n, F, maxsize):
    assigns=[a for a in range(1<<n) if not (a>>F)&1]
    idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(assigns)}
    full=(1<<len(assigns))-1
    cands=[]
    masks=[]
    for (i,j,l) in itertools.combinations(range(n),3):
        for si in (0,1):
            for sj in (0,1):
                for sl in (0,1):
                    m=0
                    for ai,a in enumerate(assigns):
                        li=((a>>i)&1)^si
                        lj=((a>>j)&1)^sj
                        ll=((a>>l)&1)^sl
                        if li+lj+ll==1: m|=1<<ai
                    cands.append((i,j,l,si,sj,sl))
                    masks.append(m)
    # pattern masks
    pat_masks={}
    for p in itertools.product((0,1),repeat=3):
        mm=0
        for ai,a in enumerate(assigns):
            if ((a>>0)&1,(a>>1)&1,(a>>2)&1)==p: mm|=1<<ai
        pat_masks[p]=mm
    need=[p for p in itertools.product((0,1),repeat=3) if p!=(0,0,0)]
    zero_mask=pat_masks[(0,0,0)]
    for size in range(1,maxsize+1):
        t0=time.time()
        for combo in itertools.combinations(range(len(cands)),size):
            m=full
            for ci in combo: m&=masks[ci]
            if m & zero_mask: continue
            ok=True
            for p in need:
                if not (m & pat_masks[p]): ok=False; break
            if ok:
                return [cands[ci] for ci in combo]
        print("  size",size,"done in",round(time.time()-t0,1), flush=True)
    return None
```

TASK ID: three-sat-to-one-in-three-sat

USER REQUEST:
Write a polynomial-time reduction from 3-SAT to 1-in-3-SAT. problems.py defines both problems: SOURCE is 3-SAT and TARGET is 1-in-3-SAT. The SOURCE and TARGET class docstrings give the exact instance formats, yes-conditions and edge cases.

PROBLEM DEFINITIONS (the SOURCE and TARGET docstrings from problems.py, complete as given here):

SOURCE = ThreeSat
3-SAT.

Instance: {"num_vars": m, "clauses": [[l1, l2, l3], ...]}
  * Variables are 1..m. A literal is +v (v is true) or -v (v is false).
  * Every clause has exactly 3 literals on 3 different variables, so a
    clause may not repeat a variable or contain both v and -v.
  * Literal order inside a clause and clause order do not matter. The
    same clause may appear more than once.
  * Variables need not all appear in a clause.

Yes iff some assignment of true/false to variables 1..m makes every
clause contain at least one true literal.

Edge cases: a formula with no clauses is satisfiable (yes), for any m,
including m = 0. A formula with clauses needs m >= 3.

TARGET = OneInThreeSat
1-in-3-SAT (positive one-in-three satisfiability).

Instance: {"num_vars": m, "clauses": [[a, b, c], ...]}
  * Variables are 1..m.
  * Every clause lists exactly 3 different variables, all as positive
    integers: negated literals are not allowed in this problem.
  * Variable order inside a clause and clause order do not matter. The
    same clause may appear more than once.
  * Variables need not all appear in a clause.

Yes iff some assignment of true/false to variables 1..m makes EXACTLY ONE
of the three variables in every clause true.

Edge cases: a formula with no clauses is yes, for any m, including
m = 0. A formula with clauses needs m >= 3.

```python
import itertools, time, sys

def search(k, maxs, timelimit):
    n = 4+k
    F = 3
    assigns = [a for a in range(1<<n) if not (a>>F)&1]
    full = (1<<len(assigns))-1
    clauses = []
    for (i,j,l) in itertools.combinations(range(n),3):
        for si in (0,1):
            for sj in (0,1):
                for sl in (0,1):
                    m=0
                    for ai,a in enumerate(assigns):
                        li=((a>>i)&1)^si
                        lj=((a>>j)&1)^sj
                        ll=((a>>l)&1)^sl
                        if li+lj+ll==1: m|=1<<ai
                    clauses.append(((i,j,l,si,sj,sl),m))
    # dedupe masks? keep
    def proj(m):
        pats=set()
        while m:
            low=m&(-m); ai=low.bit_length()-1; a=assigns[ai]
            pats.add(((a>>0)&1,(a>>1)&1,(a>>2)&1)); m^=low
        return pats
    need={(x,y,z) for x in(0,1) for y in(0,1) for z in(0,1) if (x,y,z)!=(0,0,0)}
    start=time.time()
    res=[None]
    def dfs(si,depth,cur,chosen):
        if res[0] is not None or time.time()-start>timelimit: return
        p=proj(cur)
        if not need<=p: return
        if p==need:
            res[0]=list(chosen); return
        if depth==maxs: return
        for i in range(si,len(clauses)):
            nm=cur&clauses[i][1]
            if nm==0: continue
            chosen.append(clauses[i][0])
            dfs(i+1,depth+1,nm,chosen)
            chosen.pop()
            if res[0] is not None: return
    dfs(0,0,full,[])
    return res[0]
```

```python
import itertools, sys, time

def build_candidates(n, F):
    cands = []
    for (i,j,l) in itertools.combinations(range(n),3):
        for si in (0,1):
            for sj in (0,1):
                for sl in (0,1):
                    cands.append((i,j,l,si,sj,sl))
    return cands

def mask_of(c, n, F, assigns):
    i,j,l,si,sj,sl = c
    m=0
    for ai,a in enumerate(assigns):
        li=((a>>i)&1)^si
        lj=((a>>j)&1)^sj
        ll=((a>>l)&1)^sl
        if li+lj+ll==1: m|=1<<ai
    return m

def proj_ok(m, assigns):
    pats=set()
    mm=m
    while mm:
        low=mm&(-mm); ai=low.bit_length()-1; a=assigns[ai]
        pats.add(((a>>0)&1,(a>>1)&1,(a>>2)&1)); mm^=low
    return pats

def search(n, F, maxsize):
    assigns=[a for a in range(1<<n) if not (a>>F)&1]
    cands=build_candidates(n,F)
    masks=[mask_of(c,n,F,assigns) for c in cands]
    need={(x,y,z) for x in(0,1) for y in(0,1) for z in(0,1) if (x,y,z)!=(0,0,0)}
    for size in range(1,maxsize+1):
        cnt=0
        for combo in itertools.combinations(range(len(cands)),size):
            m=(1<<len(assigns))-1
            for ci in combo: m&=masks[ci]
            if m==0: continue
            p=proj_ok(m,assigns)
            if p==need:
                return [cands[ci] for ci in combo]
        print("  size",size,"done", flush=True)
    return None

for (n,F) in [(5,3),(6,3),(7,3)]:
    print("n=",n, flush=True)
    r=search(n,F,3)
    print("result",r, flush=True)
    if r: break
```

```python
import itertools, sys, time

def search(n, F, maxsize):
    assigns=[a for a in range(1<<n) if not (a>>F)&1]
    idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(assigns)}
    full=(1<<len(assigns))-1
    cands=[]
    masks=[]
    for (i,j,l) in itertools.combinations(range(n),3):
        for si in (0,1):
            for sj in (0,1):
                for sl in (0,1):
                    m=0
                    for ai,a in enumerate(assigns):
                        li=((a>>i)&1)^si
                        lj=((a>>j)&1)^sj
                        ll=((a>>l)&1)^sl
                        if li+lj+ll==1: m|=1<<ai
                    cands.append((i,j,l,si,sj,sl))
                    masks.append(m)
    # pattern masks
    pat_masks={}
    for p in itertools.product((0,1),repeat=3):
        mm=0
        for ai,a in enumerate(assigns):
            if ((a>>0)&1,(a>>1)&1,(a>>2)&1)==p: mm|=1<<ai
        pat_masks[p]=mm
    need=[p for p in itertools.product((0,1),repeat=3) if p!=(0,0,0)]
    zero_mask=pat_masks[(0,0,0)]
    for size in range(1,maxsize+1):
        t0=time.time()
        for combo in itertools.combinations(range(len(cands)),size):
            m=full
            for ci in combo: m&=masks[ci]
            if m & zero_mask: continue
            ok=True
            for p in need:
                if not (m & pat_masks[p]): ok=False; break
            if ok:
                return [cands[ci] for ci in combo]
        print("  size",size,"done in",round(time.time()-t0,1), flush=True)
    return None

for (n,F) in [(5,3),(6,3),(7,3)]:
    print("n=",n, flush=True)
    r=search(n,F,3)
    print("result",r, flush=True)
    if r: break
```

```python
import itertools, sys
from functools import lru_cache

def find_gadget(k, maxs, timelimit=120):
    n = 3 + k
    assignments = list(itertools.product([0,1], repeat=n))
    N = len(assignments)
    full = (1<<N) - 1
    # clause masks
    triples = list(itertools.combinations(range(n),3))
    cmask = []
    for t in triples:
        m = 0
        for i,a in enumerate(assignments):
            if a[t[0]]+a[t[1]]+a[t[2]] == 1:
                m |= 1<<i
        cmask.append(m)
    # projection masks for patterns
    pat_mask = {}
    for p in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=3):
        m=0
        for i,a in enumerate(assignments):
            if (a[0],a[1],a[2])==p: m|=1<<i
        pat_mask[p]=m
    nonzero = [p for p in pat_mask if p!=(0,0,0)]
    need_mask = 0
    for p in nonzero: need_mask |= pat_mask[p]
    # proj(S): for each pattern, whether S & pat_mask[p] != 0
    # we need: for nonzero patterns all present, for (0,0,0) absent.
    import time
    start=time.time()
    result=[None]
    # DFS with memo of failed (state, last_index, depth)
    failed=set()
    def proj_ok(S):
        # returns None if invalid, or True if exactly OR
        for p in nonzero:
            if S & pat_mask[p] == 0: return False
        if S & pat_mask[(0,0,0)] != 0: return False
        return True
    def proj_possible(S):
        for p in nonzero:
            if S & pat_mask[p]==0: return False
        return True
    def dfs(S, start_i, depth, chosen):
        if result[0] is not None: return True
        if time.time()-start>timelimit: return False
        if proj_ok(S):
            result[0]=list(chosen); return True
        if depth==maxs: return False
        key=(S,start_i,depth)
        if key in failed: return False
        for i in range(start_i, len(triples)):
            nS = S & cmask[i]
            if nS==S: continue  # redundant
            if not proj_possible(nS): continue
            chosen.append(i)
            if dfs(nS, i+1, depth+1, chosen): return True
            chosen.pop()
            if result[0] is not None: return True
        failed.add(key)
        return False
    dfs(full,0,0,[])
    return result[0], triples
```

import itertools, time

OR = {(x,y,z) for x in (0,1) for y in (0,1) for z in (0,1) if z==(x|y)}

def find(k, maxs, timelimit=100):
    n = 5 + k
    assignments = list(itertools.product([0,1], repeat=n))
    triples = list(itertools.combinations(range(n),3))
    cmask=[]
    for t in triples:
        m=0
        for i,a in enumerate(assignments):
            if a[t[0]]+a[t[1]]+a[t[2]]==1: m|=1<<i
        cmask.append(m)
    def proj(S):
        p=set(); mm=S
        while mm:
            low=mm&(-mm); i=low.bit_length()-1; a=assignments[i]
            p.add((a[0],a[1],a[2])); mm^=low
        return p
    full=(1<<len(assignments))-1
    start=time.time(); res=[None]
    def dfs(S, si, depth, chosen):
        if res[0] is not None: return True
        if time.time()-start>timelimit: return False
        p=proj(S)
        if not p <= OR: return False
        if p==OR:
            res[0]=list(chosen); return True
        if depth==maxs: return False
        for i in range(si,len(triples)):
            nS=S&cmask[i]
            if nS==S: continue
            chosen.append(i)
            if dfs(nS,i+1,depth+1,chosen): return True
            chosen.pop()
            if res[0] is not None: return True
        return False
    dfs(full,0,0,[])
    return res[0], triples, n

for k in range(0,4):
    r,tri,n=find(k, maxs=6, timelimit=60)
    if r is not None:
        print("k=",k,"n=",n,"clauses:",[tri[i] for i in r], flush=True)
